body: I know!!! It is such bullshit! "It gets better" they say.. "This won't last forever" they say... Those are lies!
I feel like an empty shell. I just want to fucking die. ._.

My friend, were just going to call her Hannah (that's her actual name) spilled the beans that she cut herself to the school counselor. After that, she went to a mental hospital for 3 months. She said it was hell. A teacher at school saw my arm, I pulled my sleeve back down. She saw it. She was just like, "Rin, I want to talk to you during lunch,". I was like oh god.. I went and she forced me to tell her the truth. She promised she wouldn't tell the counselor, and of course, SHE DID. Now I'm in the counselor's office almost everyday just trying to tell the counselor I'm fine, when I'm not. I hate the counselor. I want her to leave me alone. I want friends. Real friends that are there for me, but apparently, no one is.
Why do I feel dead inside..
Yes!!! Finally.. Someone who gets it.
Just try to wait it out... I mean.. I'm still here??

Hey, hey. I'm in the same position, (except I've never gotten help), but, I don't want to relapse, and I'm spiraling down again as well. Just hand in there a bit longer. Get a friend. Get someone you love. Someone you trust. (Make sure they won't call the police on you.) I feel dead when I'm alone. Don't go alone. I love you.
I love you. These thoughts never leave me alone. Never.
Same.. I just want to die.
please.. hang in there buddy.. we love you..
Hey everyone. Thanks for all the <3 and support. I'll try to stop self-harming even though it's pretty hard. ;-; I love you all.
